name: OpenTable homepage — restaurant reservation hub by opentable.com
description: A utility-first reservation homepage that leads with a pill-shaped search bar (date, time, party size, location) and a red CTA, then settles into image-led card carousels where every card repeats the same anatomy: photo, bookmark, name, star rating, cuisine/price/neighborhood meta line, social proof, and an outlined 'find next available' button. Red (#DA3743) is the only saturated colour on white until the page's chapter breaks — a soft mint-to-peach AI prompt banner mid-page and a saturated orange-red-purple gradient banner for restaurateurs near the end. Density is high in the card rows, opens up through the illustrated FAQ and three-column city-link grid, and the page closes with a dark navy five-column footer, giving the scroll a clear card-row → editorial → utility → footer rhythm.
